spells.name: Cascading Fire Cloak
spells.effect: The caster has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Embody the Blaze
spells.effect: The target can immediately use a **^^Fight^^** ability as if it were the combat phase. The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Flaming Blades of Ruin
spells.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Fulminating Flame-cage
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares an ability for the target, as a reaction, roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick an enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Repression
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from run rolls and charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 0.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Volcanic Blast
spells.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
